Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring motorcycle manufacturers to indicate whether a motorcycle is for off-road use only.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to requiring motorcycle manufacturers to indicatewhether a motorcycle is for offroad use only; and adding a new sectionto chapter 46.70 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.70 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: To ensure that motorcycles are accurately registered with thedepartment, if a motorcycle does not meet federal motor vehicle safetystandards, the manufacturer's statement of origin or certificate oforigin must include a statement indicating that the motorcycle is foroffroad use only.
